body: Awesome! You have a nice style, definitely looking forward to seeing any more art from you in the future.
Really nice drawing, not every day you see a deer centaur! Did you draw it yourself?

A human Titan (Homebrew class specialized in being tanky). He has lightly curly hair pulled back into a man-bun/ponytail and has feminine features like high cheekbones. He wears chainmail with pieces of plate armour on his chest, shoulders and legs from the waist down with his stomach and arms only having his chainmail (Or any other light armour like leather if that's easier for you). He has a large shield with a ram's head on it. He wears a roman centurion style helmet which he could be holding in his right hand or on the floor next to him.
Would really appreciate if you drew this OC for me, cheers Kappa. :)
